correctness.rationale: A fresh exhaustive definition-level 2^16 arc-mask enumeration gave 261 augmented faces with nonempty f=(16,76,120,48), 704 nonempty covers; independent acyclic-Morse elimination had 115 pairs, critical (1,1,20,8), integral d2 primitive row with 3 +1 and 3 -1, integral d3=0. Hurewicz after cancelling the unique one-cell yields 19 S² and 8 S³. Independent F2 boundary ranks d1,d2,d3=(15,61,40), and 101-field 48x120 top-kernel, integral trace bound 8, exact D4 signed Lefschetz give H2 (19,-1,3,-1;1,1,1,1), H3 (8,0,0,0;0,0,0,0). Sources actual pinned RESULT.md/verify_morse.py/verify_character.py, plus separately written checks.
residual_risks: Exact finite verification cannot imply an unasserted parametrized generalization; all conclusions bounded as stated.
